kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: allow-allowed-client-to-server
  namespace: policy
spec:
  podSelector:
    matchLabels:
      app: server
  policyTypes:
    - Ingress
  ingress:
    - from:
        - podSelector:
            matchLabels:
              role: allowed
      ports:
        - protocol: TCP
          port: 80
EOF
kubectl apply -f allow-client-policy.yaml -n policy
